name: TW-PKM-Schema
description: TW plugin provides the schema of the pkm suite: field definitions, vocabularies, icons, labels, translations and the pkm-* API

paragraphs: Source of the TiddlyWiki plugin $:/plugins/nikorion/pkm-schema, the schema of the pkm suite: the fields a tiddler of a pkm wiki can carry, their controlled vocabularies, icons, labels and translations, and the API the other pkm plugins read them through — TW-PKM-Fields: the editor, and the columns of TW-Dynamic-Table, which itself knows nothing of the schema. Pure wikitext, no JavaScript, no UI of its own but a reference tab.

This README is for whoever wants to change the schema. What the fields mean for a wiki user, and how to use them in wikitext, is the plugin's own readme (src/pkm-schema/language//readme.tid). The online demo calls the API live in its Playground.
